publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for organization opening-hour routes and behavior.
Service contract for weekly opening-hour slots, exceptions, and effective-hours reads.

dependsOn.description: Opening-hour records prove the owning location belongs to the requested organization and tenant through the organizationLocations service seam.
Tenant-admin opening-hour routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing weekly slot, exception precedence, or effective-hours semantics can break public-facing schedules, exports, and future booking slices.
Changing opening-hour route context behavior can break root and tenant scoped child-resource consumers.
